statements.statement: Town meeting passed a citizens petition appropriating money for the schools, contingent on a future override election
Health insurance costs are reportedly seeing significant increases
The school budget is on a growth model that needs to change or more money will need to be found
The Council on Aging plans to seek a program coordinator position in its FY27 budget

warnings.prediction: The town lacked a full plan last year and is likely to be in the same budget situation again next year

warnings.about: staffing cuts and bumping during budget season
warnings.prediction: Staff will again go through cuts and bumping this year and next, and the town is losing employees over the recurring turmoil
